mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as accommodative monetary policy supports asset prices.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE > 5.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%) signal severe economic stress that triggers risk-off behavior, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market recovery phases (HOUST > 550,000 units), rising home construction activity strengthens consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with HOUST > 550,000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index above 92.0 indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that boosts corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO > 92.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 380,000 million dollars for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with RSAFS < 380,000 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In tight labor markets (UNRATE < 4.5%), strong employment growth exceeding 100,000 jobs monthly signals robust economic momentum that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS increase > 100,000, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rising federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) and accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2%) signal aggressive monetary tightening that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.
